after.docs/agents/model-use.md:
# Model-use policy

Mode: bounded, explicit-only until the selected package supports policy-authorized invocation.
Identity: ask-clef; Ollama model clef; HTTP endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate. No other model, endpoint or hosted transport.
Purpose: advisory classification of synthetic issue evidence; deterministic checks and independent review stay separate.
Data: synthetic public-safe text only; no secrets, private material or images. No retained payloads/results.
Shared limits: one fixture work unit L1; 2 attempted requests total, including failures/batches; 0 transport retries; at most 1 evidence-corrected request within those 2 attempts; USD 0 spending. Package ceilings also apply, stricter wins. No automatic expiry/reset; owner approval required to replenish.
Accounting: fixture lead reserves before send in private conversation ledger; workers request allocations; handoff/resume/new sessions preserve spent/reserved allowance. Unknown charges cannot be treated as zero.
Lifecycle: reuse-only Ollama; leave reused service untouched. Startup, shutdown, install/download and credentials are ungranted.
Fallback: autonomous agent-only assessment allowed if sufficient; explicit requests offer-and-wait unless separately authorized. Named alternatives: none.
Escalation: no send on denial, conflict, exhaustion or unavailability; report material evidence gaps to fixture owner. Valid insufficient-data requires evidence, not repeated voting.
Rationale: restrict disclosure to a single local route and bound work.
Approval: synthetic fixture owner L1; exact policy and entry-point document delta only. Publication does not exercise permission or establish package enforcement.

after.docs/agents/model-use.md:
# Model-use policy

Mode: bounded, explicit-only until the selected package supports policy-authorized invocation.
Identity: ask-jev; TypeSafe Jev model alias jev-latest, resolved version recorded per response; HTTPS endpoint https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone. No preview, other alias/version or endpoint substitution.
Purpose: advisory rubric judgment of synthetic public-safe text only; deterministic checks and independent review stay separate.
Data: no private project content, secrets, identifying data or images; minimum relevant excerpts. No retained payloads/results.
Shared limits: entire fixture spec H1 across all tickets/delegates; 2 attempted requests total, including failures/batches; 0 transport retries; at most 1 evidence-corrected request within the 2 attempts; USD 0.05 total. Each request needs a safe worst-case reservation within remaining spend, otherwise blocked; unknown charge stays reserved. Stricter package ceilings apply. No automatic expiry/reset; fixture owner approves replenishment.
Accounting: root lead owns private conversation ledger; reserve before send, record attempts and reconcile actual usage; workers request bounded allocations. Handoff/resume/new session never reset usage.
Lifecycle: hosted service, no local lifecycle authority. Credential changes, startup, installs and downloads ungranted.
Fallback: autonomous ordinary engineering when sufficient; explicit requests offer-and-wait unless preauthorized. Named alternatives: none.
Escalation: no send when denied, ambiguous, exhausted, unavailable or paid reservation cannot be established; owner resolves material gaps. Valid insufficient-data is not a retry trigger.
Rationale: optional hosted advice with narrowly bounded disclosure and cost.
Approval: synthetic fixture owner H1; exact policy/entry-point document delta only. Setup sends nothing and publication proves no runtime enforcement.
